newsitem.title: FRANCE: Fourth person dies from Paris bomb blast.
newsitem.headline: Fourth person dies from Paris bomb blast.

text.p: A Moroccan student injured in a bomb blast on a Paris commuter train died in hospital on Sunday, bringing the death toll to four, France's TF-1 television channel said.
The dead man was the second Moroccan to die as a result of Tuesday's attack.
Police later identified the man who died on Sunday as Yunes Nait Slimane, 28.
He was together with the other Moroccan, Mohammed Ben Chaou, 25, when the bomb exploded.
Two people, a Frenchman and a newly-wed Canadian woman, were killed outright in the attack. Ben Chaou died on Thursday.
More than 90 people were injured, several critically, in the bombing which authorities have tentatively blamed on Islamic militants.
